title: Restricted associated-sheaf functor to abelian sheaves
statement: For a commutative ring R and an open W of Spec R, the functor from R-modules to abelian sheaves on W associates the module sheaf, restricts along the inclusion of W and forgets the scalar action. It sends zero morphisms to zero.

source.place: Tags 01I6 and 0A6T; associated sheaves, restriction and exactness

proof.text: Compose Mathlib tilde.functor, Modules.restrictFunctor and SheafOfModules.toSheaf. The zero-map identity follows from tilde.map_zero and the componentwise definitions of restriction and forgetting.
